g.text: ENGINEERING SMOKE — not scientific results · Selected competence and cue checks · dots show seeds; bars show cue-group means

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526270

g.text: Fresh support is a privileged diagnostic and never enters the online mixer. Cue benefit is flipped minus correct affected-case Brier.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #526270

g.text: Qualification additionally requires adequate specialist error and gains over a training-only marginal predictor; these checks are in the saved summary.
